primaryChecks.text: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.
primaryChecks.nextContext: The LORD was with Judah, and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.

primaryChecks.text: The LORD’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck thirty men of them. He took their plunder, then gave the changes of clothing to those who declared the riddle. His anger burned, and he went up to his father’s house.
primaryChecks.previousContext: So Manoah took the young goat with the meal offering, and offered it on the rock to the LORD. Then the angel did an amazing thing as Manoah and his wife watched.
primaryChecks.nextContext: But Samson’s wife was given to his companion, who had been his friend.
